warnings.issue: `help-llm` advertises the tool name and all example commands as `commandindexdev`, but the packaged binary name is `commandindex` (`Cargo.toml:2`). LLM consumers or users copying these commands will invoke a non-existent executable and fail. The same mismatch is repeated in the new `after_help` text constants (for example `src/cli/index.rs:7` and `src/cli/search.rs:15`).
warnings.impact: Generated/copied commands from help output fail at runtime; this undermines the new LLM integration and CLI help guidance.

summary: 1 warning found. The new help surfaces consistently document `commandindexdev` while the actual binary/package name is `commandindex`, so the primary regression is incorrect command guidance rather than a panic or security flaw. I did not find a new path traversal, command injection, SQL injection, unsafe, or secret-exposure issue in the changed code paths.
